blocks.x: Fault-to-fix down 63% and street-light energy down 22% — urban asset platform
A metropolitan city government — a Public Sector & Government engagement delivered by a blended Achala IT Solutions team under the outcome-linked engagement model.
Lighting/traffic/water assets vendor-siloed; data not shared.
Faults reported by citizens; maintenance unscheduled. Public-space sensing raised privacy concerns; governance missing.

The urban telemetry fabric brought multi-vendor assets into governed streams with privacy-by-design tags; condition-based maintenance orchestration schedules work citywide; and the urban OT security program (segmentation, monitoring) protected public systems — governance evidence accepted by the data-protection authority.

the controls were architectural — identity-first, segmented, instrumented — not bolted on after the fact.

blocks.x: Colleagues ask what the metropolitan city government program proves. It proves the pattern works when the baseline is honest; it cannot prove your numbers, which is exactly why the diagnostic comes first The engagement model here was build-transfer; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
